meta.averaging: Canonical colours are the OKLab mean of visible (alpha>0) pixels, converted back to sRGB, CIELAB and OKLCh. Animated textures are first time-averaged in linear RGB. Face overall colour is the OKLab mean of top + bottom + four sides (weights 1+1+4). Naïve sRGB means are stored on each face as hex_naive for comparison.
meta.distance: CIEDE2000 in CIELAB (D65, 2°) on the Lab of the OKLab-mean colour.
notes: Textures and models are © Mojang Studios, extracted from the official client for analysis. They are not redistributed as a resource pack.
Redstone ore is excluded with other redstone components, even though it is a natural ore.
Leaf blocks are excluded as plants, even though builders often use them.
Chests, shulker boxes, signs, beds, vaults, spawners, beacons and respawn anchors are excluded as entity/special utility blocks.

Copper bulbs and redstone lamps are excluded as redstone-controlled lights; glowstone, sea lanterns, shroomlights, froglights, magma, crying obsidian, jack o'lanterns and sculk catalysts are included.
